regime_context: The TSX is under oil-led leadership (Oil & Gas Producers rank 1, eligible, crowded) with a narrowing rotation foundation (6 of 16 eligible, one_narrative false). Big Banks are the only tenable challenger (eligible, trend-like, uncrowded), while the rest of the tape lacks trend eligibility. Detector grades this as discipline not prediction: the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, so this note calibrates modestly.
emerging_watch: Watching Big Banks for a confirmed leadership handoff from Oil & Gas: waiting for the rotation margin (currently 1.02) to compress below roughly ~0.3 AND Banks' breadth to widen above ~0.55 while staying eligible; the watch retires if Oil re-accelarates and the margin re-widens toward fresh highs.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil is the only wide-coverage (breadth 1.0) eligible leader with full trend support. theses.subject: Big Banks

evidence: eligible true, hurst_tag trend (cleanest trend tag in top ranks)
theses.dissent: The handoff is NOT confirmed — rotation margin 1.02 and absorption 0.3 say oil leadership persists; chasing the challenger before a confirmed switch is buying hope, not trend.
